title: lpm.config.json
description: Source-package configuration for `lpm add`. Lives at the tarball root; declares the configurable surface, file copy rules, and dependency injection logic that `lpm add` interprets when delivering the package's source into a consumer project.

$schema.description: Optional pointer to this schema for editor autocomplete. Recommended value: https://lpm.dev/schemas/lpm.config.json

ecosystem.description: Target ecosystem for the source files. Drives default install directory detection (e.g., Swift uses `Sources/<target>/` or `Packages/LPMComponents/Sources/<target>/`).

importAlias.description: Author's import alias prefix used in the source files (e.g., `@/components`). `lpm add` rewrites occurrences in the copied source to match the consumer project's tsconfig.json paths or the explicit `--alias` flag.

configSchema.description: Map of configurable field name → field specification. Each entry drives an interactive prompt during `lpm add` (or a `--yes` default) and feeds the inline-config map used by `files[].condition` and `dependencies` lookups.

defaultConfig.description: Map of configurable field name → default value, overriding any `default` declared in the matching `configSchema` entry. Useful for sharing common defaults across packages without duplicating the field spec.

files.description: Ordered list of file copy rules. Each rule names a source pattern, an optional destination, and an inclusion mode. Rules with `include: when` are gated by a `condition` map keyed against the resolved inline-config values.

dependencies.description: Conditional dependency injection map. Outer keys match `configSchema` field names; inner keys match the user's selected value(s) for that field; values are arrays of dependency names that get added to the consumer's `package.json` and resolved by the package manager `lpm add` was invoked with (`--pm` selects between `lpm`, `npm`, `pnpm`, `yarn`, `bun`, or `auto` for project-state detection; default `lpm`). Names from any registry are accepted — npm-published, private-registry, and `@lpm.dev/*` packages all flow through the same path; auth or access errors surface at install time. Each name is currently appended with a `*` range; preserving an explicit version range from the schema is a planned follow-up. Declaring this field opts out of the legacy `package.json#dependencies` + `peerDependencies` fallback even when no conditional branch matches the consumer's config.

configValue.description: A leaf value for a configurable field. Native JSON booleans, numbers, and strings are all accepted; the runtime stringifies them when populating the inline-config map.

type.description: Field input type. `string` prompts for a free-form value, `boolean` for a confirm, `select` for a single-choice or multi-select list.

label.description: Human-readable prompt label. Defaults to the field name when omitted.

default.description: Initial value for the prompt. Overridden by `defaultConfig.<fieldName>` at the package level.

required.description: When `true`, the field is filled with its default value under `--yes` if the user didn't supply it inline.

multiSelect.description: Only meaningful when `type` is `select`. When `true`, the prompt accepts multiple values; the resolved inline-config value is comma-joined.

options.description: List of selectable options. Only meaningful when `type` is `select`. Plain strings are accepted as a shorthand for `{value, label}` pairs where both equal the string.

value.description: Stored inline-config value when this option is selected.

label.description: Human-readable label shown in the prompt. Defaults to `value` when omitted.

src.description: Source path or glob (relative to the tarball root). Trailing `/**` and `/*` are supported.

dest.description: Destination path (relative to the consumer project's resolved install dir). Trailing `/` treats the value as a directory and preserves the source filename. Omit to keep the source-relative path.

include.description: When to include this rule. `always` (or omitted): copy unconditionally. `when`: copy only if every entry in `condition` matches the inline-config value (all-by-default if a key wasn't supplied). `never`: skip.

condition.description: Required when `include` is `when`. Map of inline-config field name → expected value. Native booleans/numbers are accepted alongside strings; comma-separated multi-select values match if any element equals the expected value.
